mapper.select: SELECT id AS workflowId, concurrency_policy, max_parallel_runs FROM workflow WHERE id = #{workflowId} AND deleted = false
SELECT id AS projectId, max_concurrent_tasks FROM project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND deleted = false
SELECT count(*) FROM task WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND status IN ('SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING', 'STOPPING') AND deleted = false
SELECT count(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status IN ('SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING', 'STOPPING') AND deleted = false
SELECT task_id FROM task WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND status IN ('SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING', 'STOPPING') AND deleted = false LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS queueId, max_concurrent_tasks FROM queue WHERE id = #{queueId} AND deleted = false
SELECT count(*) FROM task_step ts JOIN task t ON t.id = ts.task_id WHERE t.queue_id = #{queueId} AND ts.status IN ('SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING') AND t.deleted = false
